items.altText: A coloured 1967 land use capability survey map for the Gisborne–East Coast region, with mapped classes and land-resource information.
items.caption: Land use capability survey, Gisborne–East Coast Region, 1967. Sourced from LINZ. Crown Copyright reserved.
items.context: The National Library catalogue describes this first-edition regional survey as a 1967 map at 1:126,720, with sheets for land capability, recommended land use and rock-type erodibility. It is an example of the paper classification and mapping work that preceded digital inventory use.
